newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela seizes cocaine bound for Germany.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela seizes cocaine bound for Germany.

text.p: Venezuela's National Guard said it seized 220 pounds (100 kg) of cocaine on Friday in a shipment that was to be sent to Germany.
The drugs were concealed in an industrial sawing machine. The raid in the Caribbean port of La Guaira 20 miles (30 km) from Caracas led to eight arrests, including a Spaniard.
In another drug bust in western Trujillo state, national guardsmen found 119 pounds (54 kg) of cocaine hidden in a car.
Venezuela is not a major drug producer but has become in recent years an important transit point for drugs from neighbouring Colombia bound for the United States and Europe.
